join.title: Join a household
join.shared: You will keep one budget together and see each other's receipts.
join.private: Mark a receipt private and the household sees only its amount, in a monthly sum.
join.yours: Only you can change your receipts, and you can leave at any time.

stats.loadFailed: The household's statistics could not be loaded
stats.empty: No receipts from anyone in the household in this period.
stats.privateNote: Private is everyone's receipts marked private, added up: only the amount is shared.

card.title: Household
card.intro: Keep one budget with your partner or family. Members see each other's receipts, except the ones marked private, and only the person who added a receipt can change it.
card.name: Household name
card.ownerStays: To leave, remove the other members first: a household needs its owner.
card.deleteQuestion: You are the only member, so the household will be deleted. Your receipts stay yours.
card.leaveQuestion: You will no longer see the household's receipts, and it will no longer see yours.
card.budgetSet: Household budget: {{amount}} {{currency}} a month, set by the owner.
card.budgetNone: The household has no monthly budget yet; its owner can set one.
card.budgetInvalid: Enter an amount above zero, or leave it empty.
card.inviteHint: Send it to the person you want to share a budget with. Anyone with the link can ask to join, so get a new one if it reaches someone else.
card.replaceQuestion: The current link stops working at once. Members already in stay.
card.removeQuestion: {{name}} will no longer see the household's receipts, and it will no longer see theirs.
